learning_objective: 🎯 Let us become shape detectives and learn all about flat shapes, solid shapes, their edges, and corners!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Flat shapes like squares and circles are drawn on paper (2D). Solid shapes like blocks and balls take up space (3D) and you can actually hold them in your hands!
An edge is the straight line where two faces of a solid shape meet. A corner (or vertex) is the pointy part where the straight edges bump into each other!
Run your hand over a round ball, it has a curved surface. Now touch your math book, it has a flat surface. Some objects, like a water bottle (cylinder), have both!

fun_activity.title: 🧊 Shape Detective Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Find three solid objects in your house (like a dice, a book, or a party hat). Count their straight edges and pointy corners, and tell your family what shapes they are!

quick_recap: ⭐ Flat shapes are 2D, while solid shapes are 3D and take up real space.
⭐ An edge is a straight line on a shape, and a corner is where the edges meet.
⭐ Objects can have flat surfaces, curved surfaces, or sometimes even both!
